summary: Load web write schemas lazily and use the read schema at startup

schema.detail: Generated wire contracts and validation are unchanged; only browser module loading boundaries change.

rules.detail: No rule changes or accessibility exemptions.

compatibility.detail: Upload, send, folder edits and terminal actions retain their generated validation and refusal handling. Full startup savings require the SDK lazy codec changes in #5277.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; existing lazy chunk recovery is reused without retrying mutations.
